text: A gene showing ω (dN/dS) significantly greater than 1 along a particular lineage is best interpreted as evidence for:
explanation: ω > 1 means nonsynonymous substitutions are accumulating faster than synonymous ones, which is the signature of positive/diversifying selection favoring amino acid change. ω < 1 instead indicates purifying selection removing deleterious changes, ω = 1 indicates neutral evolution, and incomplete lineage sorting is an unrelated process concerning discordance between gene and species trees, not a selection signature.
